native_code: QGfit 1.0.0 (github.com/qian-yang/QGfit, commit 3aed692); vendored copy patched for the LSQ-only UnboundLocalError (fitter.run_fit_conti, line.run_fit_line_one) and the missing-MCMC-block KeyError in prop.cal_prop

units.qgfit_line_flux: integral over rest-frame wavelength, 1e-17 erg s-1 cm-2
units.qgfit_model_csv: rest-frame f_lambda (observed * (1+z)^3); do not compare directly with observed-frame continuum columns from sibling tools

mcmc.note: continuum emcee chain; converged when N_tau >= 50, 0.05 <= acceptance <= 0.70 and the median posterior width is 0.5-2.0 times stderr_lsq/sqrt(redchi)
mcmc.convergence_note: N_tau=8.0 (target >= 50), acceptance=0.297 (pass), median MCMC/LSQ width=1.41 (pass). The marginal widths now match the LSQ covariance, but the chain is only 8 tau long; 50 tau would require ~4977 steps, i.e. ~2.8 h at the measured ~2 s/step. The production budget stopped at 1000 steps (800 after burn).

line_mcmc.reason: line MCMC disabled in the configuration
line_mcmc.note: 50x300 line-MCMC pilot rejected: per-complex tau=20-42 steps, N_tau=5-11, redchi_mcmc ~6e10 versus LSQ chi2_nu=11.5; LSQ covariance retained.

line_fit.Hbeta_OIII5007_note: native QGfit template: single narrow [O III] component capped at FWHM<=1200 km/s; expanded template adds a broad [O III] wing

statistical_mode.continuum: emcee MCMC via lmfit (100 walkers x 1000 steps, burn 200); width-converged, not 50-tau converged
statistical_mode.note: Line MCMC is run independently per emission-line complex and does not propagate continuum uncertainty. line MCMC disabled in the configuration 50x300 line-MCMC pilot rejected: per-complex tau=20-42 steps, N_tau=5-11, redchi_mcmc ~6e10 versus LSQ chi2_nu=11.5; LSQ covariance retained. Continuum chain: N_tau=8.0, width ratio median=1.41 (pass); a 50-tau chain would need ~4977 steps (~2.8 h), beyond the production budget.

scope.note: QGfit is run on the observed SDSS spectrum without Galactic dereddening; the sibling tools also use the observed SDSS spectrum with EBV=0.  The H-beta total is the sum of the QGfit broad+narrow components; QGfit's BIC test can remove a narrow component when it is not required.  The native QGfit narrow-line profile is hard capped at FWHM=1200 km/s, so a broad [O III] wing can only be represented with an expanded line template.
